newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woodside to boost reserves - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woodside to boost reserves - newspaper.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd plans to announce later this week a huge increase in gas reserves which will underpin the A$6 billion expansion of the North-West Shelf gas project, The Australian Financial Review reported on Monday.

"Sources close to the company said Woodside will announce this week that proven gas reserves will rise more than 60 percent from 15 trillion cubic feet (tcf) to 24 tcf, enough to lock in vital long term contracts for liquefied natural gas from Japanese buyers," the newspaper reported.
It said reserves of condensate would be also sharply upgraded towards 500 million barrels.
